config.method: merge_config.sh -m with the mt7668 and usb-ethernet fragments and the changes below, then make olddefconfig on the patched v7.2.11 tree (GCC 16.2.1)
changes: PS4_CPUFREQ, new with the rmux stack, is off for the first boot candidate
PS4_DMI_SPOOF, new with the rmux stack, is off until it checks the running console
PREEMPT_VOLUNTARY no longer exists on x86; make olddefconfig selects PREEMPT, as rmux's 7.0.8 and 7.1.7 configs do
all other differences are Linux 7.2 Kconfig changes resolved by make olddefconfig
